en.lead: I'm a full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of experience and a focus on the backend: REST and GraphQL APIs, integrations and distributed systems with Node.js and TypeScript, and web applications with React and Next.js. Today I work on PayPal's Node.js and GraphQL platform.
en.body:
At Trocafone I went from frontend to backend developer and then tech lead. I led five major projects and the migration of a legacy PHP monolith to microservices in Node.js, Python (FastAPI) and .NET Core, behind a GraphQL gateway and deployed with Docker and Kubernetes.

Since then I've built serverless, event-driven services on AWS with Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS and Step Functions; GraphQL services with NestJS and Next.js applications on Azure; and, at PayPal, GraphQL schemas and resolvers used by several platform services. I work with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB and Redis.

I care about what keeps a system reliable once it's in production: idempotent message processing, tests with Jest, CI/CD pipelines and observability. I also review code and take part in architecture decisions with the team.
en.technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, REST APIs, Python, React, Next.js, AWS, Azure, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Jest
